name: io.github.mmoonport-labs/unifi-mcp
title: UniFi Gateway
description: UniFi Network and Protect through search, describe and call, with dry-run-first changes. Unofficial.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_URL
environmentVariables.description: Gateway address, e.g. https://192.168.1.1. Not needed after running `unifi-mcp setup` once.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: UniFi API key (Settings > Control Plane > Integrations). Not needed after `unifi-mcp setup`.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_CERT_SHA256
environmentVariables.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the gateway's certificate, to pin it. `unifi-mcp setup` sets this for you.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to refuse every change to the gateway.
